testCases.name: test_case_14
testCases.input: My website does not appear in search engine results. I need help with indexing and optimizing my site's SEO to ensure it gets listed.
testCases.actualOutput: Ensure the "Let search engines index your site" toggle is enabled in your SEO settings. Verify that your site is properly indexed by checking if pages are crawled and indexed, and consider using the Wix SEO Setup Checklist for optimization. If your site still doesn’t appear, it may be due to competitive ranking or indexing limitations on certain pages.
testCases.expectedOutput:
When you publish your site, most of your pages are available for search engines like Google to crawl and index so that they can appear in search results. It can take some time for your page to appear. 
However, search engines cannot guarantee that every page of your site will be indexed. It's important to note that this is perfectly normal in many cases. 

To check if your site was indexed by search engines, search "site:" followed by your site's domain with no spaces. For example: site:wix.com
  If any of your domain's pages are listed in the search results, those pages have been indexed. If there are no results for your domain, your website has not been indexed yet. 

Step 1 Check that you have allowed search engines to crawl and index your site.

To enable search engines to index your site:
1. [Go to your SEO dashboard.] (https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-f3388913-140f-47a9-b2ba-4bf86b60e04e&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO)
2. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings.
3. Make sure the Let search engines index your site toggle is enabled.

Step 2 Check if your pages has any redirects
Wix's URL Redirect Manager lets you create 301 redirects for pages on your site. 301 redirects tell web browsers that the URL of a page on your site has changed permanently to a new URL. It also tells browsers that visitors who try to access the page's old URL should be sent to the new URL instead.

If your page has a 301 redirect and the page doesn't appear in search results, try deleting the redirect.

1. [Go to your SEO Dashboard.] (https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-f3388913-140f-47a9-b2ba-4bf86b60e04e&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO)
2. Select Go to URL Redirect Manager under Tools and settings.
3. Hover over the 301 redirect that you want to delete.
4. Click the Delete icon 

Step 3 We recommend using the Wix [SEO Setup Checklist] (https://support.wix.com/en/article/improving-your-online-presence-with-the-wix-seo-setup-checklist) to optimize your site's SEO and submit your site to Google for indexing. The SEO Setup Checklist helps you pick the best keywords, title tags, and meta descriptions to rank higher. It also helps you connect your site to Google Search Console.
After you've completed the SEO Setup Checklist, your site is submitted directly to Google for indexing.

Step 4 Sitemaps give information to search engines like which pages are on your site and when they were last updated. Every Wix site has a sitemap that updates automatically with your site’s most current information. Learn more about your site's sitemap file
When you complete the steps in your Wix SEO Setup Checklist, Wix automatically submits your sitemap index to Google for you. When you make changes to your site, your sitemap will be automatically updated with the changes. There's no need to submit your sitemap to Google again. 
If you want to submit your sitemap yourself, or submit it to other search engines, you can submit your sitemap directly. 

1. Go to [Google Search Console.] (https://search.google.com/search-console)
2. Select your site from the drop-down.
3. Select Sitemaps.
4. Enter the URL slug of the sitemap you want to submit under Add a new sitemap.
For example, to submit the sitemap for your entire site, enter sitemap.xml. 
5. Click Submit.

Step 5 If your site is indexed, but not showing as high as you like in search results, [optimizing your site's content for SEO] (https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-sites-content-for-seo) can help your site rank higher. Similar to the SEO Setup Checklist, optimizing your site's content  helps search engines find and understand your site.
A more technical but powerful way to improve your site's ranking is to use structured data markup. This is a standardized format for giving search engines detailed information about your page. 
Adding markup to your site's pages can help improve your website's search results and ranking. Search engines like Google can also use markup to [create rich results] (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/advanced/structured-data/search-gallery) like article previews, product previews, and FAQs for your page's search results.
context:
Site or Pages Not Appearing in Search Engine Results
When you publish your site, most of your pages are available for search engines like Google to crawl and index so that they can appear in search results. It can take some time for your page to appear. If you've published your site but it's not appearing in search results, the information in this article can help you get your site on Google and other search engines. However, search engines cannot guarantee that every page of your site will be indexed. It's important to note that this is perfectly normal in many cases. For example, search engines recommend not to index certain pages, such as Wix Blog archive pages. Wix automatically prevents search engines from indexing these pages. In this article, learn more about: 
Checking if your site is indexed Fixing issues that stop your site and pages getting indexed Using the Wix SEO Setup Checklist Submitting your sitemap directly to Google Optimizing your site for SEOChecking if your site is indexedTo check if your site was indexed by search engines, search "site:" followed by your site's domain with no spaces. For example: site:wix.comIf any of your domain's pages are listed in the search results, those pages have been indexed. If there are no results for your domain, your website has not been indexed yet. Check that you have allowed search engines to crawl your site. Fixing issues that stop your site and pages getting indexedIf a certain page on your site is not listed in search results, you can try the steps below to get it indexed.Make sure that the page is publishedSearch engines can only index pages that you have published. Any pages that you add after the last time you published your site won't appear in search results. This also applies to changes you make to the content of a page. If you changed your page after the last time you published, search engines won't be able to index the changes.  Make sure to publish your site when you're finished making any changes or edits to it. Note:
It can take some time for changes to your site's pages to appear in Google search results. testCases.name: test_case_15
testCases.input: My website stopped working, and I received a DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error. I havent made any changes to the domain, and its connected to Wix. I also encountered an error with ID 7809 and the opcode QUERY.
testCases.actualOutput: The DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error typically indicates that the domain cannot be resolved, which may be due to DNS propagation issues or misconfigured DNS records. Since your domain is connected to Wix and you haven't made changes, check if the DNS records have propagated using whatsmydns.net. If the issue persists, use the Wix Technical Assistant to troubleshoot or contact Wix support for assistance.
testCases.expectedOutput:
To resolve the DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error and the error with ID 7809 and opcode QUERY for your Wix-connected domain, follow these steps:

1. **Check DNS Records**: Use [whatsmydns.net](https://www.whatsmydns.net/) to verify that your domain's DNS records are correct and have propagated globally. Ensure that the A and CNAME records match those required by Wix.

2. **Flush DNS Cache**: Clear your browser's cache and flush your DNS cache on your computer. For Windows, open Command Prompt as an administrator and type `ipconfig /flushdns`.

3. **Verify Domain Status**: Ensure your domain is active and not expired. You can check this on [whois.com](https://www.whois.com/).

4. **Check Domain Assignment**: Make sure your domain is correctly assigned to your Wix site. Go to the [Domains](https://manage.wix.com/account/domains) page in your Wix account to verify this.
context:
Wix Domain Assistant
Important:From January 17th, 2024 some legacy DNS records are no longer supported for sites connected to Wix by pointing. If your site is affected, you should have received an email notifying you to update the A Record and CNAME records in your domain's host account (not Wix). Go to the pointing section below and click Check and update your DNS records to learn which records your domain should have. This article can help you troubleshoot issues with the various domain connection methods. If you are experiencing issues with your domain connection, follow the steps below.Unsure if you've connected via name servers or pointing?Learn the difference between the two connection methods. Issues with a domain purchased from WixTo resolve issues with a domain purchased from Wix, make sure you have done the following:Make sure your site is publishedNew edits and changes to your site are not automatically reflected on your live site. Make sure to publish your site to make your changes go live.

To publish your site: 
Click Publish at the top right of your editor. (Optional) Click View Site to go to your live site. Click Done.Make sure your domain hasn't expiredIf your domain has expired, you'll need to resolve the payment issue to reconnect your site.

To check the expiration date of your domain:
Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Check the information in the Next Payment Due column.
Note: Click Update Payment Method under the relevant domain to renew your domain. 
If your domain is not listed in Premium Subscriptions:
Make sure you've signed in to the correct Wix account.  Check that your domain isn't in the redemption period.  Go to Domains in your Wix account to check if you've transferred your domain from another Wix account.
Note: View the expiration date to the right of your domain name.
Note: 
Learn how to resolve payment issues for your Wix domain.  If you've recently completed a payment for your domain, it can take up to 48 hours for your site to be live again. Learn about domain propagation. Check that your Premium or Studio plan subscription is still activeYou must have an active Premium or Studio plan subscription for your site to be connected to a domain.
To check the status of your plan subscription:
Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the Expand icon  to the relevant plan subscription. View the status of your plan next to Status.Note: If your plan status is Expired, you must upgrade to a new plan to reconnect your site to your domain.Check that your domain is assigned to the correct siteIn order for your live site to appear, your domain must be assigned to a site with a Premium or Studio plan.
To assign a domain in your account to a site:
Go to Domains in your Wix account.
Note: If you have more than one domain in your account, scroll to the domain you wish to assign.  Click Assign next to Not Assigned to a Site.

Note: If your domain is currently assigned to a different site, click the Domain Actions icon  on the right and select Assign to a Different Site. Select a site and click Next.
Note: If the site is currently connected to a different domain, choose an option:
    
Redirect it to the primary domain: Redirect your domain to the site's primary domain that is already connected.   Replace the current primary domain: Connect your domain and disconnect the site's current domain.    Click Assign.Check your domain's DNS records in your Wix accountDomains purchased from Wix automatically have the correct DNS records configured in your account. If your A (Host) or CNAME (Aliases) records have been changed, you'll need to correct them for your site to reconnect.

To check and update your DNS records:

Wix Payments: Guidelines for Uploading Documentation
Wix may request that you send the following documents in order to verify your Wix Payments account. The photo ID is used to verify that the identity of the Wix Payments account owner (personal or business) matches the identity of the bank account owner.Important:All documents* must be issued within the same country you select as your business location. Documents may be rejected if issued from another country.(*For a business Wix Payments account, your ID may be issued from any Wix Payments supported country).Learn about the guidelines for uploading documents for:
Photo identification Address verification  Bank details Company detailsPhoto IDYour photo ID must meet the following requirements:
Your photo ID can be a passport, driver's license or a government issued ID card Your photo ID must be active and non-expired The photo must be in color Your ID must show all 4 borders and corners The ID must not have information blocked or blacked out The ID must be straightened, not angled or rotated The ID must not be blurry, overexposed or copied from another source (e.g. screenshot) Your first, middle and last name in your Wix Payments account must match those of your ID Your birth date in your Wix Payments account must match that of your ID For passports with a Machine-Readable Zone (MRZ), the MRZ must be visible. For driver's licenses or government issue ID cards, send a separate file for each side Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG The maximum file size is 10 MB The minimum file size is 1 KB for PDF, 100 KB for other formatsAddress verification documentProvide a document, such as utility bill, which verifies the address you have submitted. Your address verification document should meet the following requirements:
Documents must be visible and clear Documents must be dated within the last six months Complete documents must be uploaded. A complete document is defined as:
    
One full page of the document (at minimum) The full name and address of the individual are clear and visible   Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNGUsers in Canada must provide separate documents for identity and address verificationBank detailsTo verify your bank details, you can provide one of the following documents:
A bank statement A voided check Official letters issued by a bankSee below for the requirements for uploading each of these types of documents.Bank statement
Provide a color copy of your statement The bank logo should be visible and clear The full bank account number should be visible and clear  The document must have been issued within the last 12 months The bank account holder’s name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments accountVoided check
The word "VOID" should appear on the check The bank's logo should be visible and clear The bank account number should be visible and clear Bank account holder/company name must be printed, not handwritten The check must be issued and printed by the bank Voided check must not be part of a direct deposit form The bank account holder’s name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments accountBank letter
The bank logo should be visible and clear The bank account number should be visible and clear The letter must be issued and printed by the bank The document must have been issued within the last 12 months The letter must have a bank agent signature The bank account holder’s name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments accountGuidelines for uploading bank statements, voided checks and bank lettersBanking documents may be rejected if:
The document is blurry The document is not legible (font too small) The document is torn or damaged The document is rotated or upside down The image is a mobile screenshot The full account numbers are not displayed The name/company on your document do not match details in your account The account numbers are incorrect It is not a bank statement, but a direct deposit form The voided check is not printed by a financial institutionPlease also note:
Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG The maximum file size is 10 MB The minimum file size is 1 kB for pdf, 100 kB for other formatsCompany detailsYour business document must meet the following requirements:
The tax ID/registration number should be visible and clear The company name should be visible and clear and match the business details in your Wix Payments account (If applicable) Company director documents should contain the legal entity name and list all registered directors The document must have been issued within the last 12 months Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG The maximum file size is 10 MB The minimum file size is 1 kB for PDF, 100 kB for other formatsCompany director documentsCanadian corporations may need to provide a document listing the company’s directors, if requested to do so.You can submit any one of the following documents, as long as it contains an up-to-date list of the directors of your company:
A current and valid government issued document that contains the entity name and directors Corporate profile report Articles of Incorporation or Association Notice of Articles Notice of Change of Directors (e.g. Form 6, Form 4006, Form 3006) Board meeting minutes/resolution dated within the last 12 monthsFor name changes:
You may have changed your business name and the name on the business registration document does not match your current legal business name. testCases.expectedOutput:

  Log In to Your Wix Account: Begin by logging into your Wix account and accessing your site's dashboard.

Allow clients to start booking your services by upgrading your site. Alternatively, you can display your services (without allowing bookings) on a free Wix site.Wix offers a range of site plans especially designed for businesses. To start getting booked and accepting payments, visit our Upgrade page to find a plan that best suits your business needs. To choose a plan:
If you have not already done so, add Wix Bookings to your site. Go to your site's dashboard. Click Upgrade.
 Click Select under the plan that suits your needs. Click to select the relevant subscription period and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details. Click Submit Purchase.Important:

When switching plans, if the new plan costs more than the original plan you purchased, you pay only the difference in price.
retrievalContext:
Wix Bookings: Upgrading Your Site
Allow clients to start booking your services by upgrading your site. Alternatively, you can display your services (without allowing bookings) on a free Wix site.Wix offers a range of site plans especially designed for businesses. To start getting booked and accepting payments, visit our Upgrade page to find a plan that best suits your business needs. To choose a plan:
If you have not already done so, add Wix Bookings to your site. Go to your site's dashboard. Click Upgrade.
 Click Select under the plan that suits your needs. Click to select the relevant subscription period and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details. Click Submit Purchase.Important:

Go to your editor. Go to your Book Online page:
    
Click Pages  on the left side of the editor. Click the Book Online page under Bookings Pages.   Click the Book Online element on your page. Click Settings. Click Display. Under Service Actions, select the Explore Plans Link checkbox.What's next?
Check out the full course on Wix Learn about offering packages.  Make sure to customize the look of your membership plan.  Why not create a package to offer your clients more flexible options when booking your services? Packages are a great way to introduce clients to your services without the need to make a big commitment.

please feel free to contact Wix Customer Care and we'll be happy to help you. FAQsClick on a question below to learn more about Premium plans.Why am I asked to upgrade if I already purchased a plan?Since different plans offer different features, it's possible that you're trying to use a feature that's not included in your plan. For example, if you purchased the Light plan, you won't be able to accept payments through your site. Go to Premium Subscriptions to check which plan you purchased.Another possibility is that you upgraded the wrong site. Site plans are valid for a single site only. However, if you upgraded the wrong site, you can easily reassign the plan to the correct one.Can I access all Wix products without purchasing a plan?Free

Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage  at the bottom. Tap Booking Calendar. Tap Booking List. Tap the Search by client icon . Enter the client name in the search field.   Tap the checkbox to select the relevant client from the list. Tap Apply.  Tap Sell a Plan.

testCases.name: test_case_18
testCases.input: The picture on my mobile site is dark. Its a standalone image that was carried over from my desktop site. I need guidance on adjusting the image settings for my mobile site.
testCases.actualOutput: To adjust the image settings for your mobile site, click Background on the left side of the mobile editor, then click Settings. Adjust the opacity, scale, and scroll effect to customize how the image appears. If needed, you can also change the image's fill color, border, corners, or add a shadow under the Design options.
testCases.expectedOutput:
To adjust the settings of a standalone image that was carried over from your desktop site to your mobile site, you can follow these steps:
  1. Click the Settings icon .
  2. Customize the following:
  - Image Behaviors: Decide how your visitors interact with images.
  - When an image is tapped: 
  - Nothing happens: The image is not clickable, nothing happens when it's clicked.
  - A link opens: The image acts as a button and can be linked to a page, anchor on your site, an external URL, and more. 
  - It opens in a popup: The image opens in a pop-up window.
  - Image Resizing: Decide what happens when your images are resized.
  - Keep Proportions: The image and shape stay at the original proportions when resized.
  - Auto-fill: The image automatically adjusts to fill the space on your visitor's device.
  
  You can also add and customize mobile-only images to replace the picture with a lighter one. Follow these steps to do it: 
  
  1. Click Add to Mobile on the left of the mobile Editor.
  2. Click Image.
  3. Select the image type you want to add.
  4. Click the image you want to upload and click Add to Page.
context:
Wix Editor: Adding and Customizing Images on Your Mobile Site
Create a beautiful visual experience on your mobile site by refining the images carried over from your desktop version, as well as customizing the images you add from the mobile editor.Customization of images carried over from desktop is limited - you can adjust your image settings, crop the image and add fun animations. With images that you add from the mobile editor, you have full control over customization - add filters and frames, customize what happens when an image is clicked and more.In this article, learn more about:
Carrying images over from desktop Adding images from the mobile editorNot sure if it's a mobile or desktop element?Mobile-only elements display a mobile icon  when you click them.Images carried over from your desktop versionImages you add to the desktop version of your site are automatically carried over to your mobile site. You can customize the image's settings, crop it, and add an animation to make it different from the desktop version.To customize images carried over from desktop:
Click the image in your mobile editor. Depending on what you want to customize, do the following:Change my image settingsCustomize how your visitors interact with your images as well as what happens when images are resized on different mobile devices.
Click the Settings icon . Choose from the following customization options:
    
Reset Image Proportions: Reset the images original proportions. Image Behaviors: Decide how your visitors interact with images.
        
When an image is clicked: 

Nothing happens: The image is not clickable, nothing happens when it's clicked. A link opens: The image acts as a button and can be linked to a page, anchor on your site, an external URL, and more.  It opens in a popup: The image opens in a pop-up window. It can be magnified: The image is magnified when it's clicked.

      Crop my imagePresent a new version of your image in your mobile view by manually cropping your image or use a shape crop.
Click the Crop icon .    Drag the slider to zoom the image in and out. Choose how you want to crop your image:

Upgrading Universal Analytics to Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
You can track information in Google Analytics about your site visitors using either a Google Analytics 4 (GA4) property or a Universal Analytics (UA) property.Follow the steps below if you're already using Universal Analytics with your site and want to upgrade to Google Analytics 4. Important:
From July 1, 2023, UA properties will stop collecting data from your website. After you upgrade to GA4, we recommend continuing to use both properties. Learn how to use both By using this service, you are engaging directly with a third-party service provider. We recommend reviewing the service provider's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use prior to your use of such third-party service. You acknowledge that we are not liable for any loss or damage resulting from your use of such third-party service, including any liability arising from any personal data exchanged between you and such third-party.Step 1 | Create your Google Analytics 4 propertyUse the GA4 Setup Assistant in your Google Analytics account to create and set up a new Google Analytics 4 property. To create a GA4 property:
Sign in to your Google Analytics account.  Click the Admin icon  at the bottom left of the page.
Select GA4 Setup Assistant.
Click Get Started under I want to create a new Google Analytics 4 property. Click Create property. Click See your GA4 property under Explore and set up your GA4 property. Select Tag installation.
Select your stream under Data Streams. Click the Settings icon . Click Show advanced settings under Page views. Deselect the Page changes based on browser history events checkbox. 
Disable the Site search toggle. Click Save.Step 2 | Add your Google Analytics 4 property to your siteAdd your new property to Google Analytics in Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard to complete the upgrade.To add your GA4 property:

Paste your Google Analytics 4 measurement ID in the pop-up. 
Note: Make sure that there are no extra spaces before the code. 
(Optional) Select the IP Anonymization checkbox if you want to hide your site visitors’ IP addresses from Google.  Click Save.Using UA and GA4 properties at the same timeAfter you upgrade to GA4, we recommend continuing to use both properties. This ensures continuity in the data you collect and gives you time to learn more about the data you can collect with a GA4 property. Note:Your UA property will stop collecting data after July 1, 2023. You can enable tracking using both properties in the Admin section of your Google Analytics dashboard. To use both properties:
Sign in to your Google Analytics account.  Click the Admin icon  at the bottom left of the page.  Select the UA property that you want to connect from the drop-down under Property. Select Property Settings. Copy the property's tracking ID. Select the GA4 property that you want to connect from the drop-down.  Select Data Streams. Select the data stream that you want to connect. Select Manage connected site tags under Additional Settings. Add your UA tracking ID under Enter ID of tag to connect. (Optional) Add a nickname for your connected tag. Click Connect. Tip:You can disconnect your properties if you need to by clicking the More Actions icon  beside the tag and selecting Remove tag.

testCases.name: test_case_20
testCases.input: The user is inquiring about how the billing works with Google Ads.
testCases.actualOutput: Google Ads uses a pay-per-click (PPC) model, where you pay each time one of your ads is clicked. Ad credits are applied to your account and can be used to offset costs, but they are only spent if your campaigns receive clicks. Billing is based on actual ad performance, with charges reflecting daily spending up to your allocated budget.
testCases.expectedOutput:
Google Ads with Wix campiagns can be paid with a monthly subscription or a one-time payment.
  
  Your monthly subscription is the amount billed monthly for all the campaigns you're running with Google Ads with Wix. It is applied directly to the total ad credit each month (ad credit available across all the campaigns).
  
  Your monthly subscription includes:
  - The amount billed monthly (before VAT) as a whole for all campaigns you run with Google Ads with Wix.
  - The Wix fee* and tax.
  
  *Wix gets 15% of your payment for running and optimizing your campaign. The remaining 85% goes towards your ad credit which is spent on ad clicks.
  
  You can pause your campaign at any time to stop using the ad credits. If the paused campaign was your last active campaign on the account, auto renew is turned off for the subscription.
  
  However, if you want to purchase additional ad credit, you can make a one-time purchase of credits that are added to the total in your account. You can then readjust the daily budget of one or more campaigns as needed. This won’t affect your overall monthly subscription.
  
  You can manage your subscription from the campaigns page of your dashboard. Click Manage Spend & Credits at the top to update your monthly subscription or adjust your daily spend across all campaigns you're running.
context:
Google Ads with Wix: FAQs About Your Monthly Subscription, Daily Spend, and Ad Credits
From the main campaigns page in your Google Ads with Wix dashboard you can view and manage your subscription. You can also adjust your daily spend across all your campaigns and make one-time payments.Click a section below to learn more about your Google Ads with Wix subscription, daily spend, and ad credits.In this article, learn more about:
Your monthly subscription, ad credit, and daily spend Ad credits for live or paused campaigns How your ad spend works Making one-time payments The Google Ads $500 promotional credit Currency questionsYour monthly subscription, ad credit, and daily spendWhat is the difference between a monthly subscription, ad credit, and daily spend?
Monthly subscription: The amount billed monthly (before VAT) as a whole for all campaigns you're running with Google Ads with Wix. The monthly subscription amount is applied directly to your ad credit each month. Ad credit: The total sum of money available to run ads across all your campaigns. Ad credit is only spent on ad link clicks and clicks to CTA buttons. Note: Your ad credit is paid in USD regardless of the currency you pay your subscription in. One-time ad credits: A one-time purchase of extra credits for when you want to promote a specific sale or event, or give a specific campaign(s) a boost and get more clicks.  Daily spend: The amount of money you set for a specific campaign to spend on clicks per day. You can set a different daily spend for each campaign using your ad credit. Your daily spend is optimized to be spent only on ad link clicks and CTA button clicks. The amount will be paid up front, and is not pay-per-click.What does my Google Ads with Wix subscription include?Your Google Ads with Wix subscription includes:
The amount billed monthly (before VAT) as a whole for all campaigns you run with Google Ads with Wix. The amount is applied directly to your ad credit each month.  The Wix fee* and tax.*Wix gets 15% of your payment for running and optimizing your campaign. The remaining 85% goes towards your ad credit which is spent on ad clicks.Does Wix charge a fee?Wix gets 15% of your payment for running and optimizing your campaign, the remaining 85% goes towards your ad spend which is spent on ad clicks. Prices do not include VAT, which is determined based on your billing country.What does my ad credit include?Your ad credit may include your monthly subscription, any rollover ad credit from previous months, as well as any qualifying Google Ads credit applied to your account. If you pay in a supported currency (e.g. EUR, GBP, JPY, USD) the ad credits are in the same currency. For all other currencies, ad credits in your dashboard show as USD.How is my ad credit spent?Google Ads use PPC model of digital advertising. PPC stands for pay-per-click, a system where the advertiser pays a fee each time one of their ads is clicked. Essentially, you're paying for targeted visits to your website (or landing page or app).Therefore, in some cases, the ad credit might not be used if the campaign is not clicked.How do I manage my subscription?You can manage your subscription from the campaigns page of your dashboard. Click Manage Spend & Credits at the top to update your monthly subscription or adjust your daily spend across all campaigns you're running.Ad credits for live or paused campaignsWhat happens to my ad credit if I pause a campaign?You can pause your campaign at any time. As soon as you pause, the following changes happen:
Your ad is no longer shown on Google. Your remaining ad credits stay in your account. If the paused campaign was your last active campaign on the account, auto renew is turned off for the subscription.Note: Any Google Ads credits that have an expiry date may expire while the campaign is paused.Can I use my remaining ad credit for a paused campaign without purchasing a new subscription? Yes. Ad credit is saved in your account. If your subscription expires, you can run a campaign on the remaining ad credit until it is gone. Then the campaign will stop.How your ad spend worksHow do I change the daily spend of my campaign?
From the main campaigns page, click Manage Spend & Credits at the right. View the ad credits remaining in the current billing cycle. Click Adjust Daily Spend to change your daily spend. Enter a new daily spend for the campaign(s) you want to change. If you are running more than one campaign, you can see the total daily spend across all your campaigns.
Note: If you don't have enough for the new daily amount, you can increase your monthly subscription. Click Save to update your daily spend. If you have also increased your subscription, you will go through the checkout process at this step.What happens to my daily spend if it is not fully utilized within the month?As Google uses the PPC (pay-per-click) model, it is possible that the your daily spend will not be fully utilized due to a lack of clicks. If this is the case, your remaining spend will be added to the total ad credits for the following month.How does my daily spend work if I am running multiple campaigns?You pay for one Google Ads with Wix subscription regardless of how many campaigns you run. You can also always buy extra ad credits with a one-time payment that are added on top of your subscription. Your ad credits are used to run your ads.When you choose a daily spend for a new campaign, it's taken from the total 'bucket' of ad credits available for all campaigns in your account. To get more ad credits, Click Manage Spend and Credits in the campaigns page and increase your subscription.How do I view my Google Ads with Wix invoices?All invoices for Wix services can be viewed in the Billing History page of your account. Invoices may include VAT, which is determined based on your billing country.Making one-time paymentsHow do I make a one-time payment?
Click Manage Spend & Credits in the campaigns page. Click Manage Ad Credits. Select Purchase one-time ad credits and choose an amount. Click Purchase Credits.What is the difference between a monthly subscription and a one-time payment?Your monthly subscription is the amount billed monthly for all the campaigns you're running with Google Ads with Wix. The monthly subscription amount is applied directly to the total ad credit each month (ad credit available across all the campaigns).
However, if you want to purchase additional ad credit, you can make a one-time purchase of credits that are added to the total in your account. You can then readjust the daily budget of one or more campaigns as needed. This won’t affect your overall monthly subscription.About the Google Ads $500 Promotional CreditWhat are the requirements for receiving the promotional credit ($500 for USD subscriptions) offer from Google?You are eligible for the ad credit as long as you meet the following conditions: 
You are new to Google advertising. You have not run a Google Ads campaign previously with your site. You have spent $500 USD (or your currency equivalent ) on ad clicks in the first 60 days after launching your campaign.Note: If you have run a campaign in the past with Google Ads, you will not be eligible, even if this is your first campaign with Google Ads with Wix.Is Google's promotional credit offered for different currencies?Yes. Your promotional credit is based on the currency you used to pay for your subscription.Below is a list of what you need to spend on Google to get promotional credit:
USD: Spend 500 USD to get 500 USD EUR: Spend 400 EUR to get 400 EUR GBP: Spend 400 GBP to get 400 GBP JPY: Spend 60,000 JPY to get 60,000 JPY Every other currency: Spend 500 USD to get 500 USD. (e.g. if converting AUD to USD you must spend roughly 725 AUD to reach 500 USD threshold).Can I use Google's promotional credit to cover the renewal of a subscription?Unfortunately, it is not possible to use the credit to cover a subscription renewal. This credit must be used towards your campaign.How long do I have to spend the ad credit after receiving it?You need to spend the ad credit within 60 days of receiving it in your account. After 60 days, the ad credit expires.How is the ad credit applied to my account?After you have spent $500 USD within the first 60 days, Google automatically applies the amount to your available ad credits. You will receive an email about the new credit, as well as a dashboard notification.Why am I not seeing the credit immediately?Purchasing a Google Ads with Wix subscription does not apply the credit immediately. The promotional credit is applied to your account after you spend $500 USD on ad clicks. Then it is applied to your account.Note: Since the credit comes directly from Google, it may take a few days to see the credit applied to your account after you have fulfilled the requirements.Currency questionsWhat if I choose to pay for my subscription in a currency other than USD?You pay for your monthly Google Ads subscription to Wix in the currency of your choice. This is applied to your ad credits that are spent on clicks. If you pay for your subscription in an unsupported currency, your monthly subscription gets converted into US Dollar (USD) to pay Google for the ad credits you spent on clicks.You can find the exact conversion value for the current subscription period next Monthly Subscription on your dashboard.What are the Google Ads supported currencies?The supported currencies that Wix can apply to your ad credits to pay Google are:
US Dollar (USD) Euro (EUR) Great British Pound (GBP) Japanese Yen (JPY)If you pay Wix for your monthly subscription in one of these currencies, it will be applied to your ad credits in that currency.Why was I charged for Google Ads in USD when that isn't my currency?Wix automatically determines your billing currency by geolocation. If you pay for your Google Ads with Wix subscription in an unsupported currency, your subscription is converted into USD ad credits each month to pay Google.This conversion from monthly subscription to ad credits in USD happens when your initial subscription is purchased, and repeats each time the subscription renews.Note: Your Google Ads dashboard also shows your ad credit in USD.

context:
Wix Editor: Adding and Setting Up Advanced Menus
Upgrade your menus to an advanced menu to display items the way you want. Advanced menus allow you to create custom menus for different areas of your site, deciding where your visitors should go next.Step 1 | Add a menu to your pageGet started by adding a menu to your site. There are lots of different designs to match your site's look and theme.To add a menu:
Click Add Elements   on the left side of the editor. Click Menu & Anchor. Choose a menu type under Menus. Click and drag your chosen menu to the page.  Repeat steps 1-4 for any more menus you want to add.Want the full range of features that advanced menus have to offer?We recommend adding a horizontal menu so you can have advanced design features, as well as the option to create sub-dropdown-items.Step 2 | Set the menu as an advanced menuAfter you add your chosen menu to your site, update it to an advanced menu to separate it from your site pages and unlock new features. To set a menu as an advanced menu:
Click the menu in your editor. Click the Settings icon . Click Set as Advanced. Click Set as Advanced in the pop-up. Repeat steps 1-4 for any menus you want to set as advanced.Step 3 | Add menu itemsChoose what you want to display in your advanced menu. You can add pages, links, anchors, and drop-down menu titles to organize and display content the way you want.To add items to the menu:
Click the menu in your editor. Click Manage Menu. Click + Add Menu Item at the bottom of the panel. Choose the item type you want to add to your menu:
    
Site Pages: Add site pages as menu items. Link: Add a link to your menu. You can link to external sites, documents, and more. Section: Add a page section as an item to your menu. When visitors click it, they're brought to the section. Anchor: Display a link to a page anchor on your menu. Clicking it brings the visitors to the relevant anchor. Dropdown title: Add a dropdown to your menu. Once you add the title, you can drag and drop menu items to be displayed in the dropdown. Mega menu: Add a container that's displayed when visitors hover over the item in the menu. You can change the layout and design of the container, and add elements. Learn more about mega menus  What's next?
Tailor your advanced menu by adding, removing, and renaming items. You can also set up dropdown menus and sub-dropdown menus to streamline your content. Learn more about managing menu items Depending on the menu type (horizontal or vertical), you can customize the layout and design of your advanced menu to make it look how you want.
retrievalContext: New menus:

Hover over the relevant section in your Editor. Click the More Actions icon . Click Section Settings. Enter the section name into the field under What's this section's name?. Press the Enter key on your keyboard.Note:Section names are not visible to site visitors unless you add them to a menu.Adding sections to your menuAdding sections to your menu is a great way to help your visitors navigate your site, and direct them to the right content. Making sections a menu item is also particularly useful if you have a one-page site that contains a lot of information, as visitors will be able to find what they're looking for without having to scroll.To add a section to your menu:

Add the menu to a Master section (e.g., header, section, footer). Click the Masters icon  on the top of Editor X. (From the Site Masters panel) Click the More Actions icon  on the section that contains the menu. Select Show on... Select the checkbox next to either:

Click Manage Site Menus. Click + Add New Menu at the bottom. Enter a name for the new menu.
Note: This name isn't visible to visitors.

context:
Requiring Customers to Sign Up Before Making Purchases
Important:This article is relevant for Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New).You can limit guest checkout on your site so that visitors can browse what you offer, but need to become site members before they can access the Cart Page to begin the checkout process. By requiring customers to sign up, you save their information. This makes it possible for customers to track their orders on your site and make future purchases without re-entering information.In this article, learn more about:
Restricting purchases to signed in customers Frequently asked questions (FAQs)Note:There are certain ways to complete an order without going through the Cart page (see the FAQs section for more details). In these cases, restricting access to the Cart page won't stop customers from completing orders without signing in. Restricting purchases to signed in customersEdit the permission settings for the Cart page so that only signed in members can access it. You can also choose to limit access to a member role you created or to clients who have purchased a pricing plan. Before you begin:If you don't already have it, add the Wix Members Area to your site.Wix EditorStudio Editor
Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu  on the left side of the editor. Select an option:
    
My site has only Wix Stores:
        
Click Store Pages. Click Cart Page.   My site has only Wix Bookings:
        
Click Bookings Pages. Click Cart Page.   My site has Wix Restaurants Orders (New) or 2 business solutions:
        
Click Cart & Thank You. Click Cart Page.    
Click the Settings icon  next to Cart Page.  Select the Permissions tab. Click Members Only. Decide Which members can access this page:
    
All members. Only selected members or paying customers: Limit access to a member role you created or to clients who have purchased a pricing plan.   
Go to your editor. Go to your Cart page: Click Pages  on the left side of the editor. Select an option:

Click Cart & Thank You. Click Cart Page.    
Click the More Actions icon next to Cart Page.  Click Settings. Select the Permissions tab. Click Members Only. Decide Which members can access this page:
    
All members. Only selected members or paying customers.  FAQsClick a question below to learn more. How can my Wix Stores customers go straight to checkout, bypassing the Cart Icon and Cart Page altogether?If you have the type of store where customers often purchase a single item, you may want to streamline the checkout process by allowing customers to bypass the Cart Icon, Side Cart, and Cart Page. To do so, enable the Buy Now button on the Product Page. 
Click the Product Page in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Settings tab. Scroll down and click the Show button toggle under Buy Now to enable it.
Can Wix Bookings customers also go straight to checkout?Yes, you can use Wix Bookings without Cart Checkout enabled. This will ensure they don't see the Cart Icon and Cart Page.

context:
Wix Editor: Customizing Your Mobile Menu
Customize your mobile menu to perfectly suit your site's design and layout. Your mobile menu consists of three elements; the menu icon, the menu container, and the menu items. You can customize and adjust each of these individually to create a unique, eye-catching menu for you and your visitors on mobile.In this article, learn more about: 
Customizing the menu icon Adjusting the design of the menu container Customizing the menu items Important:This article refers to the mobile menu that was released at the beginning of 2019. You can update to the new one in just a few clicks. Learn how to update the mobile menuCustomizing the menu iconThe menu icon has two states; open and closed. You can select a preset icon, and customize both states to look however you'd like. To customize the menu icon:
Click the menu icon in your mobile editor. Click the Design icon . Select a preset from the options available. Click Customize Design. Select which state you'd like to customize the icon for by clicking a tab (Closed or Open). Choose how you want to design the icon:Customize the fill color and opacityYou can choose an eye-catching color for your icon, and set its visibility.Click the Fill Color and Opacity tab  and customize it with the options: 
Button Background: Click the color box to select a color for the button background, and  drag the slider to increase or decrese the opacity. Icon: Click the color box to select a color for the button icon, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.Add and customize a border around the iconAdd a border to your icon to make it stand out on your mobile site. Click the Border  tab to set the color, visibility and width:
Opacity and Color: Click the color box to select a color, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity. Width: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the width of the border.Customize the icon's cornersClick the Corners tab  to make the icon corners rounder, or more square: 
Lock / Unlock: Click the icon  to enable or disable the corners having the same radius. Radius: Enter the radius of the corners into the field.Add and adjust a shadow for the iconAdd a shadow to give your icon a cool 3D effect. Click the Shadow tab  to add and adjust a shadow with the below options:
Enable Shadow: Click the toggle to enable or disable a shadow. Angle: Enter the angle into the text box. Distance: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the distance between the icon and the shadow. Size: Use the slider to adjust the size of the shadow. Blur: Drag the slider to adjust the shadow's blur. Opacity and Color: Click the color box to select a color for the shadow box, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.Customizing the menu containerThe menu box contains your menu items. Using the layout, design, and background panels, you can adjust the position and look of your menu container to suit your site. To customize the menu box:
Click the menu icon in your mobile editor. Click Edit Menu. Click the menu container. Choose how you want to adjust the menu container with the options below:Adjust the container's layoutChoose the layout of the container to match your site's alignment, and keep your menu sleek.Click the Layout icon  and select an alignment for your menu:
Full Screen: The menu container opens to full screen. Left: The menu container is opened to the left of the screen. Right: The menu container is opened to the right of the screen.Change the container backgroundSelect either a beautiful color or gradient for your container background, or a stunning image.  Click Change Background, and choose from one of the following options:
Color or Gradient: Click Color to select a color to match your site's theme, or stand out, or set up a sophisticated, beautiful gradient. Image: Choose an image from the media manager. You can use free images available from Wix, or upload your own.Customize the container's designAdjust the overlay that displays over the rest of your site when the menu is open. Click the Design icon , and use the settings to customize the overlay:
Color: Click the color box to select a color for the overlay. Opacity: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity of the overlay.Note: This option is only available if you set the container's alignment to the left or right of the screen from the Layout panel.Menu items misplaced?You may be experiencing one of our known issues, which we're working hard to resolve. Learn more about this issue and see workaroundsCustomizing the menu itemsAdjust the look and design of your menu items (the menu text). You can customize settings such as the font, color, and spacing. To adjust the menu items:
Click the menu icon in your mobile editor. Click Edit Menu. Click the mobile menu. Choose how you want to adjust the menu items with the options below:Menu items layoutAdjust the layout of the items to further customize the menu, and suit your site's alignment.Click the Layout icon  and use the below options:
How's text aligned?: Select whether text is aligned to the left, right, or center of the menu container. How's the submenu arrow aligned?: Select whether the submenu arrow is aligned to the left or right of the item text.Menu items designThere are a range of design options available for your menu items. You can customize how the items look in two states; regular, and selected.Click the Design  icon, and select either the Regular or Selected tab to customize the states:
Regular:

Fill Color and Opacity : Click the color boxes to select a color, and drag the sliders to increase or decrease the opacity for the menu and submenu background, and the submenu arrow background. Border : 
        
Opacity and Color: Click the color box to select a color for your border, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity. Border Style: Select whether to have the border displayed on all sides, the bottom only, or not at all.   Shadow :

Enable Shadow: Click the toggle to enable or disable a shadow. Angle: Enter the angle into the text box. Distance: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the distance between the menu and the shadow. Size: Use the slider to adjust the size of the shadow. Blur: Drag the slider to adjust the shadow's blur. Opacity and Color: Click the color box to select a color for the shadow box, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.   Text : Use the below options to customize both the menu, and the submenu items:
        
Theme: Choose a text theme from the dropdown menu. Font: Select a font for your menu items from the dropdown menu. Font size: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the size of the font. Formatting: Add a bold or italic effect to your text. Color: Click the color box to select a color for your text.   Spacing : Drag the sliders to increase or decrease the offset of the menu and submenu items.  
Selected:

Fill Color and Opacity : Click the color boxes to select a color, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity of the menu and submenu background. We recommend trying a different default font or switching to a supported font, as some default fonts may not render correctly on mobile. If the issue persists, contact Wix support for further assistance.
testCases.expectedOutput:
Different browsers and devices use a variety of rendering engines which may result in minor differences in the way your font appears. Fonts also render differently between iOS and Android, and the significance of the difference can vary from font to font. 
  
  Note: Because you are experiencing an issue with one of the default fonts, we recommend choosing another similar looking font for your site. 
  
  It is also important to note that some fonts does not work on iPhone operating systems (iOS)
  Certain fonts are not be supported by iOS or other mobile devices. If a specific font on your site is not displaying properly on an iOS device, you can check [iosfonts.com](http://iosfonts.com/) to make sure the font is supported. 

  If a supported, default font is not appearing on your mobile device, or if you are experiencing other issues with text on your site, contact us and we will be happy to assist you.

Wix Editor: Troubleshooting Font Issues on Your Mobile Site
Differences in the way fonts render on mobile devices can cause issues on your live mobile site. View the info below to learn how to fix font issues on your mobile site. In this article, learn more about: 
Fonts appearing differently on mobile sites Fonts not working on iPhone operating systems (iOS)Fonts appearing differently on mobile sitesDifferent browsers and devices use a variety of rendering engines which may result in minor differences in the way your font appears. Fonts also render differently between iOS and Android, and the significance of the difference can vary from font to font. Various factors can cause elements to become misaligned or overlapped on your live site. Learn how to resolve text alignment issues on your live mobile site.Note:If you are experiencing an issue with one of the default fonts, we recommend choosing another similar looking font for your site. Some fonts not working on iPhone operating systems (iOS)Certain fonts are not be supported by iOS or other mobile devices. If a specific font on your site is not displaying properly on an iOS device, you can check iosfonts.com to make sure the font is supported. Notes:
We do not support issues with uploaded fonts. If you’re experiencing an issue with an uploaded font, we recommend trying one of the default fonts or uploading a different one. If a supported, default font is not appearing on your mobile device, or if you are experiencing other issues with text on your site, contact us and we will be happy to assist you.

testCases.actualOutput: Yes, you can use 2-step verification on Wix via the Wix app, SMS or phone call, an authenticator app, or by email. Backup codes are not currently supported. Logins from unrecognized devices require a verification code sent to your phone, email, or via the Wix mobile app.
testCases.expectedOutput:
You can verify your account using 2-step verification with the Wix app, by SMS, with [an authenticator app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-an-authenticator-app-for-2-step-verification-for-your-wix-account), or by email. 
  You can enable more than one verification option at the same time. If you choose to enable multiple options, the default prompt order is always: Wix app first, then an authenticator app, followed by SMS, and then email.

context:
Using 2-Step Verification for Your Wix Account
2-Step verification is a security feature that lets you add another layer of verification to your login process. Each time you log in from an unrecognized device, a verification code is sent to your mobile phone or email address, or you can receive a notification to the Wix mobile app. This helps prevent anyone else accessing your account without your knowledge. Note:Logins using the Wix app also require verification if 2-step verification is enabled. Before you begin:
If you want to use the email option for your 2-step verification, you need to ensure your email address is confirmed. You can find this on the Account Settings page. This is not relevant if you are just using the SMS option.  We recommend that you set up your Recovery Phone Number before enabling 2-step verification.In this article, learn how to:
Enable 2-step verification Sign-in with 2-step verification Edit your verification phone number Disable 2-step verificationEnabling 2-step verificationYou can verify your account using 2-step verification with the Wix app, by SMS, with an authenticator app, or by email. Important:You can enable more than one verification option at the same time. If you choose to enable multiple options, the default prompt order is always: Wix app first, then an authenticator app, followed by SMS, and then email.To enable 2-step verification:
Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Scroll down to 2-Step verification. Click Enable next to your preferred method of verification:Verify logins with the Wix app
Choose your device and click Next.
Note: You'll only see devices that have recently been logged in to the Wix app. Click Approve on the login request sent to your selected device.
 Choose a backup verification method (if required).
Note: You won't need to complete this step if you already have another 2-step verification method set up, such as SMS, authenticator app, or email.Verify logins by phone (SMS)
Add your phone number.
 Click OK.  Go to your phone and get the 6-digit code.  Go back to Wix and enter the code.
 Click Confirm. Note: If you are not receiving the SMS associated with your account's 2-step verification, please contact support.Verify logins with an authenticator app
Enter your Wix password in the pop-up after clicking Enable. Open your authenticator app. Scan the QR code displayed in your browser with your authenticator app, or enter the code.
 Follow any additional steps in your authenticator app to add your account to it. Click Next on the pop-up in your browser. Enter the 6-digit code that's shown in your authenticator app. 
 Click Submit.Important: If you remove your account from your authentication app, or delete the app from your mobile device, you won't be able to sign in using this method. Verify logins by email
Click Send Code to confirm your email address.
 Go to your email account and login. Copy the 6-digit code in your email. Go back to Wix and enter the code.
  Click Submit.Note: If for some reason you don't receive a verification code, please check your junk/spam folder.Important information about emails:Only the most common email domains (i.e. Gmail, Outlook, Hotmail, etc.) ﻿are eligible for 2-step verification. If your email is not supported, you'll see a message that says that your email's domain can't be used for verification.Signing in to your Wix account with 2-step verificationWhen you sign in to your Wix account with 2-step verification enabled, you need to confirm your login by approving the login in the Wix app, or by entering a code that was sent to you by SMS, authenticator app, or email.ImportantBy default, Wix remembers the device you sign in on for 30 days. We won't ask you to use 2FA to sign in on this device until the 30 days expire. If you don't want Wix to remember your device, uncheck the box marked Remember this device for 30 days.To sign-in with 2-step verification:
Sign in to the Wix login page. Select the option that is relevant to you below:By Wix app
Tap the login notification from the Wix app on your phone. Click Approve on the login request sent to your device. By phone (SMS)
Go to your phone.  Get the 6-digit code sent to you by SMS. Enter the code under Enter code here in the Wix login page.  Click Verify.Note: 
If you don't receive a code, click Lost access to your phone? on the verification page to bring you to our Account Recovery options. We recommend you try Resend Code before proceeding to Account Recovery. If you don't receive an SMS, click Call me to get a phone call from Wix and listen to the verification code instead. 
By authenticator app
Open your authenticator app on your phone. Get the 6-digit code for your Wix account.
 Enter the 6-digit code under Enter code here in the Wix login page. 
 Click Verify.By email
Go to your email account and login. Copy the 6-digit code in your email.  Enter the code in the Wix login page. Click Verify. Note: If for some reason you don't receive a verification code, please check your junk/spam folder. Click Resend Code to resend the code to your email. Note:A 2-Step verification code will only be sent if you are signing in with email and password. If you sign in using social logins (e.g. Google, Facebook) a code is not required. Editing your 2-step verification phone numberKeep all your details up-to-date by editing your phone number when you change phones or update your phone number. This helps keep your 2-step verification in place and keep your Wix account secure. Once you update your number, a code is sent to you to confirm. To edit your verification phone number:
Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Scroll down to 2-Step verification. Click Edit next to your phone number.  Enter your phone number and click OK.
 Go to your phone and retrieve the 6-digit code. Go back to Wix and enter the code.
 Click Confirm.Disabling 2-step verificationYou can disable your 2-step verification at any time if you need to. After you disable it, you can log in without any additional codes. To disable 2-step verification:
Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Scroll down to 2-Step verification. Click the drop-down and click Disable. Important:
Disabling 2-step verification means that your Wix account is protected only by your password. Wix mobile app verification requires at least one backup method. Disabling all other verification methods will also disable verification with the Wix app.

context:
Wix Payments: Updating Your Account Settings
For regulatory or security reasons, Wix Payments may periodically require information to keep your account verified. You may also wish to update your account settings if there has been a change in your circumstances, such as a change of address or bank account.You can go back and update any of your Wix Payments account settings (personal details, business details, bank account information, business description) at any time. To update your account settings:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to Wix Payments.
 Click Edit Account Details. Edit the relevant information and click Save.

Because of this, your account status temporarily goes back to Accepting Payments. During this time, you can accept payments through your site, but you cannot receive payouts to your bank account. The verification process can take up to 7 business days. Once it is complete, you will be able to receive any payouts accumulated during this time.

Wix Payments: Guidelines for Uploading Documentation
Wix may request that you send the following documents in order to verify your Wix Payments account. The photo ID is used to verify that the identity of the Wix Payments account owner (personal or business) matches the identity of the bank account owner.Important:All documents* must be issued within the same country you select as your business location. Documents may be rejected if issued from another country.(*For a business Wix Payments account, your ID may be issued from any Wix Payments supported country).Learn about the guidelines for uploading documents for:
Photo identification Address verification  Bank details Company detailsPhoto IDYour photo ID must meet the following requirements:
Your photo ID can be a passport, driver's license or a government issued ID card Your photo ID must be active and non-expired The photo must be in color Your ID must show all 4 borders and corners The ID must not have information blocked or blacked out The ID must be straightened, not angled or rotated The ID must not be blurry, overexposed or copied from another source (e.g. screenshot) Your first, middle and last name in your Wix Payments account must match those of your ID Your birth date in your Wix Payments account must match that of your ID For passports with a Machine-Readable Zone (MRZ), the MRZ must be visible. For driver's licenses or government issue ID cards, send a separate file for each side Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG The maximum file size is 10 MB The minimum file size is 1 KB for PDF, 100 KB for other formatsAddress verification documentProvide a document, such as utility bill, which verifies the address you have submitted. Your address verification document should meet the following requirements:
Documents must be visible and clear Documents must be dated within the last six months Complete documents must be uploaded. A complete document is defined as:
    
One full page of the document (at minimum) The full name and address of the individual are clear and visible   Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNGUsers in Canada must provide separate documents for identity and address verificationBank detailsTo verify your bank details, you can provide one of the following documents:
A bank statement A voided check Official letters issued by a bankSee below for the requirements for uploading each of these types of documents.Bank statement
Provide a color copy of your statement The bank logo should be visible and clear The full bank account number should be visible and clear  The document must have been issued within the last 12 months The bank account holder’s name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments accountVoided check
The word "VOID" should appear on the check The bank's logo should be visible and clear The bank account number should be visible and clear Bank account holder/company name must be printed, not handwritten The check must be issued and printed by the bank Voided check must not be part of a direct deposit form The bank account holder’s name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments accountBank letter
The bank logo should be visible and clear The bank account number should be visible and clear The letter must be issued and printed by the bank The document must have been issued within the last 12 months The letter must have a bank agent signature The bank account holder’s name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments accountGuidelines for uploading bank statements, voided checks and bank lettersBanking documents may be rejected if:
The document is blurry The document is not legible (font too small) The document is torn or damaged The document is rotated or upside down The image is a mobile screenshot The full account numbers are not displayed The name/company on your document do not match details in your account The account numbers are incorrect It is not a bank statement, but a direct deposit form The voided check is not printed by a financial institutionPlease also note:
Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG The maximum file size is 10 MB The minimum file size is 1 kB for pdf, 100 kB for other formatsCompany detailsYour business document must meet the following requirements:
The tax ID/registration number should be visible and clear The company name should be visible and clear and match the business details in your Wix Payments account (If applicable) Company director documents should contain the legal entity name and list all registered directors The document must have been issued within the last 12 months Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG The maximum file size is 10 MB The minimum file size is 1 kB for PDF, 100 kB for other formatsCompany director documentsCanadian corporations may need to provide a document listing the company’s directors, if requested to do so.You can submit any one of the following documents, as long as it contains an up-to-date list of the directors of your company:
A current and valid government issued document that contains the entity name and directors Corporate profile report Articles of Incorporation or Association Notice of Articles Notice of Change of Directors (e.g. Form 6, Form 4006, Form 3006) Board meeting minutes/resolution dated within the last 12 monthsFor name changes:
You may have changed your business name and the name on the business registration document does not match your current legal business name. If so, please upload the business registration document you currently have to your Wix Payments account. In addition, you may be requested to provide an official name change documentation that displays both the original and new legal business name. If you need assistance, please contact Customer Care. If you have recently married, but your ID does not reflect your new surname, you'll need to provide a copy of your marriage certificate. You can submit it by uploading a PDF of your marriage cert with your Photo ID. The marriage certificate can be added as the second page to a PDF file along with the ID. If you need assistance, please contact Customer Care.

context:
Changing Your Payment Provider for Accepting Credit Card Payments
Wix's in-house payment provider, Wix Payments, allows you to accept credit card payments without the need to connect to a third-party provider.If Wix Payments is not available in your region, you will see a list of locally available payment providers. Check here for available payment providers per country.  You can always change provider if you need to.Tip:Check your site's regional settings to make sure you receive all the options available in your location. Learn MoreTo change to a different payment provider:
Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard.  
Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to Wix Payments, or click See More Payment Options. Click See Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers (if you don't see your preferred provider).
Click Connect beside the provider you want to change to. Click Yes, Switch to confirm your new provider. Connect your account:
    
Have an account: Click Connect Existing Account and follow the steps to connect your account. Don't have an account: Click Create an Account and follow the steps to create your account.  Using Wix Hotels?Click below to learn how to set up and manage payments:
Wix Hotels

Setting up Your Payment Method in Wix Hotels
Important:This article refers to the original Wix Hotels. If you are using the new Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, which is not yet available to all users, please read the information here. Learn how to check which version of Wix Hotels you are using. To start renting out rooms and collecting income, set up payment methods. You can also choose a hotel currency, set a tax rate and set deposits.To set up a payment method:Go to your dashboard.Click the Hotels tab.Click the Payments tab.Select a Payment Method and enter your details: Paypal: Get paid via one of the most popular payment gateways available on the web. Paypal supports registration from almost all countries.Stripe: Quick setup and you're set to get online bookings. Supports registration from 14 countries and more than 100 currencies.Mercado Pago: This payment is for guests from Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Venezuela. Guests are asked for their ID number when booking.Offline Payments: Instantly get bookings from the web without a connection to a payment gateway. Guests aren't charged when they book online. They can pay in person.Enter your Price Settings: Currency: Set the currency for your hotel. Your room prices are displayed in this currency.Tax: Set the tax rate for your hotel (if needed).Deposit: Set the amount you want to receive upfront when guests book online.  Note: This is only available for online payments.Click Save.Note:You can set up and accept multiple payment methods in Wix Hotels.
retrievalContext:
Email from Wix Regarding Changes to Your Payment Method Settings
The security of our users' accounts is of utmost importance to us here at Wix and we are dedicated to online safety.If you update your payment method settings (how you accept payments in Wix features, such as Wix Stores, Wix Invoices etc), you receive an email saying "You changed how you accept payments on your website".It's important to note that not only the primary account owner but other roles such as an Admin (co-owner) and payments admin can make changes to payment method settings.  If you didn't authorize these changes, change your Wix account password immediately and then contact Wix Customer Care.

Using a Different Account with the Same Payment Provider
If you have more than one account with a third-party payment provider, you can switch to your preferred account to accept payments on your Wix site. Additionally, Wix automatically connects you to the most suitable payment provider available in your region by creating a deferred account for you (e.g. with Stripe or PayPal). If you wish, you can switch to a different account, with the same provider, if you already have one.If you're not sure which provider account you currently have connected to your Wix site, you can check which provider you have connected and view your current credentials before you switch.  In this article, learn how to:

Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Connect next to Wix Payments.
 Click Yes, Switch to confirm your new provider. Depending on whether you need to create a new Wix Payments account or have an existing account, follow the instructions: 
    
Don't have a Wix Payments account:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to Wix Payments.

Another reason can be that the discount has minimum requirements. Once the customer selects product options or moves to the cart, the discounted price is displayed. Learn more  What are the best ways to let customers know about my store discounts?You can choose whether you want to display discounts only in the Cart Page and Checkout Page, or in the Product Gallery, Product Page in addition to the Cart Page and Checkout. Tip: When displayed in the Product Gallery and Product Page, some conditions apply. Additionally, it can be helpful to display a banner, strip, or popup lightbox.
